title: ETL pipeline with Apache NiFi
short: As one of the core skills for a Data Engineer
body:
ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) plays a critical role in modern data engineering workflows. ETL pipelines integrate raw data from multiple sources, transform and clean the data, and perform data quality checks to ensure its reliability and consistency. These capabilities are essential for building robust and scalable data solutions.

Approach

The approach to ETL projects is not always straightforward, as it involves integrating multiple data sources, applying transformations, and ensuring data quality throughout the pipeline. In this project, we used Apache NiFi, an open-source data integration tool provided by the Apache Software Foundation. NiFi offers a visual, drag-and-drop interface with a wide range of processors for implementing ETL workflows. Each processor requires specific configurations and parameters to function correctly.

An ETL pipeline also requires both a source and a destination database. In our case, Oracle was used as the source database, while ClickHouse served as the destination data warehouse and OLAP database.

Evaluation

To evaluate the performance of the developed pipeline, we considered several key factors. First, the pipeline must execute successfully and reliably. We then assessed the processing speed of data transformations and monitored the number of processors required to complete the workflow. These metrics provide a basis for evaluating the pipeline's efficiency, scalability, and overall performance.
